title: Musk, 165K Others Demand Jensen Huang Return as Treasury Demands Nvidia Shake-Up

# Musk, 165K Others Demand Jensen Huang Return as Treasury Demands Nvidia Shake-Up


By OpenTools Team


·


November 16, 2026


Elon Musk, Uber co‑founder Travis Kalanick, and over 165,000 others have signed an open letter demanding Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO. Meanwhile, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is pushing for a 'dramatic shake‑up' with an outside hire, and demanding answers on whether Nvidia chips reached China.


## The Open Letter: 165,000 Signatures and Counting


Elon Musk, Uber co-founder Travis Kalanick, and more than 165,000 others have signed an open letter demanding[Nvidia](https://opentools.ai/organizations/nvidia) 's board reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, according to[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/elon-musk-tech-execs-open-letter-jensen-huang-return-nvidia-ceo) . The letter calls on the board to **bring Jensen back while an independent investigation establishes the facts** . Huang resigned Thursday after a 33-year run at the helm of the company he co-founded, following revelations that he had at least two extramarital affairs — one with a woman accused of spying for China, and another with a subordinate.


## The War Room: Silicon Valley Mobilizes


Behind the public petition, a more aggressive campaign is taking shape. According to[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/elon-musk-tech-execs-open-letter-jensen-huang-return-nvidia-ceo) , citing the Financial Times, Huang has discussed a possible return with people close to him. One ally told the FT they were assembling a **war room of Silicon Valley executives** to lobby for Huang's return and would seek White House support. **Everyone that matters in tech outside the frontier labs loves Jensen** , the person said, adding that the efforts had Huang's backing. Two major shareholders — investors Brad Gerstner and Gavin Baker — have also urged the board to keep all options open.


## Treasury Pushback: Bessent Wants an Outsider


Not everyone in Washington is on board with the reinstatement push. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent argued Sunday that[Nvidia](https://opentools.ai/organizations/nvidia) should look **outside** the company for its next chief, according to[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/elon-musk-tech-execs-open-letter-jensen-huang-return-nvidia-ceo) . **They need a dramatic shake-up** , Bessent said on Fox News. He then demanded Nvidia explain whether it knowingly allowed its most advanced AI chips to reach China — a question he called more important than the affair itself. Bessent gave Nvidia 10 days to deliver answers from its internal investigation,[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/elon-musk-tech-execs-open-letter-jensen-huang-return-nvidia-ceo) reported.


> "Nothing above the H200s can be sold to the Chinese. It is important to examine whether Nvidia had a culture of compliance around the US export restrictions."


**Scott Bessent** - U.S. Treasury Secretary


## National Security Questions: Did Chips Reach Beijing?


US lawmakers from both parties have demanded Huang and[Nvidia](https://opentools.ai/organizations/nvidia) appear before Congress to explain whether national security was put at risk,[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/elon-musk-tech-execs-open-letter-jensen-huang-return-nvidia-ceo) reports. Some in President Trump's own party suggest the administration must also answer what it knew about Huang's relationship with the suspected Chinese spy. In late 2025, Trump authorized sales of Nvidia H200 chips to China — but not the most advanced chips used to run AI models. Bessent's 10-day deadline for answers from Nvidia puts the company under simultaneous pressure from Wall Street, Silicon Valley, and Washington.


## The Market Context: Nvidia Earnings Loom


The leadership drama lands with devastating timing.[Nvidia](https://opentools.ai/organizations/nvidia) reports earnings Tuesday, just days after Huang's resignation, and[Semafor](https://www.semafor.com/article/11/15/2026/anthropic-ipo-set-to-define-ai-trade) notes that[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's $1.4 trillion IPO — the largest in history — is scheduled for Thursday. An analyst told Reuters that less-than-stellar Nvidia earnings could inject uncertainty into Anthropic's debut. Despite the chaos, the iShares Semiconductor ETF bounced 9.3% last week, suggesting markets may be pricing in a resolution. Musk's involvement adds another layer: his public warning that **critical deals will be lost** without Huang underscores how much of Nvidia's supplier network rested on handshake agreements, not contracts.


## What Happens Next


The timeline is tightening for all parties.


- **Tuesday, Nov 18** Nvidia reports Q3 earnings — first without Huang at the helm.


- **Within 10 days** Bessent's deadline for Nvidia's internal investigation results on China chip compliance.


- **Nov 19** Anthropic IPO on Nasdaq — the biggest test yet for AI stocks after the Huang fallout.


- **Ongoing** The 'war room' of Silicon Valley execs continues lobbying for Huang's return.
